# Cruise Planners - Kirk and Jennifer Kanter (Sand & Seas Travel)

> Independent full-service travel agency in Racine, Wisconsin, specializing in cruises, river cruises, expedition voyages, all-inclusive resorts, group travel, and custom vacations. A Cruise Planners franchise (IATA 10716506) owned by travel advisors Kirk and Jennifer Kanter, founded 2019. Phone: (262) 344-0697.

Sand & Seas Travel serves clients across Southeastern Wisconsin - primarily Racine, Milwaukee, Waukesha, Kenosha, and Ozaukee counties - and travelers nationwide. Planning services are provided at no additional cost versus booking direct. Kirk Kanter is a Tourism Australia Aussie Specialist. The agency specializes in Alaska cruises and cruise-tours, European river cruises (Rhine, Danube, Douro, Seine), luxury ocean cruises, expedition travel, Caribbean and Mexico all-inclusive resorts, honeymoons, destination weddings, first-time cruise planning, and hosted group sailings.
